display.purpose: Hero name and section monoliths; oversized uppercase Iskry, often outlined over the 3D scene.

body.purpose: Reading copy in condensed Saira; cap at 65-75ch.

shadows.name: cursor-glow
shadows.purpose: The ONLY sanctioned shadow: blue glow on the custom cursor strokes. Light, not elevation.

motion.name: expo-ease-out
motion.purpose: Decisive exponential ease-out for reveals and CTA rings.

motion.name: power3-ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for cursor and state transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global prefers-reduced-motion kill-switch; mandatory, never remove.

components.name: Enter CTA
components.description: Signature entry button: five drifting concentric white rings, no fill, no label box. On hover the disc faintly fills.
components.css: .ds-enter { position: relative; width: 150px; height: 150px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #fff; font-family: 'Saira Semi Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: none; } .ds-enter::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; transition: background 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.38,1); } .ds-enter-ring { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-enter-ring:nth-child(1) { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); transform-origin: 48% 47%; } .ds-enter-ring:nth-child(2) { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); transform-origin: 52% 49%; } .ds-enter-ring:nth-child(3) { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); transform-origin: 54% 51%; } .ds-enter-label { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-enter:hover::after { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-enter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff2f00; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-enter::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Custom Cursor
components.description: Replaces the OS pointer everywhere (cursor:none). Two white strokes plus a dot, all with a blue outer glow.
components.css: .ds-cursor { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; pointer-events: none; will-change: transform; } .ds-cursor-line, .ds-cursor-dot { position: absolute; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 1px 0 #fff inset, 0 0 1px 0 #fff, 0 2px 16px 2px #007fff; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.38,1); } .ds-cursor-line { width: 2px; height: 20px; border-radius: 2px; transform-origin: top center; } .ds-cursor-left { transform: rotate(-5deg); } .ds-cursor-right { transform: rotate(-55deg); } .ds-cursor-dot { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate3d(-50%,-50%,0) scale(0); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cursor-line, .ds-cursor-dot { transition: none; } }

components.name: Outlined Display Heading
components.description: Monumental uppercase Iskry rendered as a white stroke with transparent fill, so the 3D scene reads through the letterforms.
components.css: .ds-display-outline { font-family: 'Iskry', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: clamp(150px, 30vw, 400px); line-height: 0.8; margin: 0; color: transparent; -webkit-text-stroke: 1px #fff; } @supports not (-webkit-text-stroke: 1px #fff) { .ds-display-outline { color: #000; text-shadow: 1px 1px #fff, -1px -1px #fff; } }

components.name: Outbound Link
components.description: Inline body-scale link with an external-arrow glyph; hover shifts opacity, not color.
components.html: LinkedIn
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #fff; font-family: 'Saira Semi Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.38,1); } .ds-link:hover { opacity: 0.5; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff2f00; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-link-arrow { transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.38,1); } .ds-link:hover .ds-link-arrow { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-link, .ds-link-arrow { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: A dark, cinematic control surface where the interface itself is the proof of competence. Content floats over a fixed near-black WebGL field with a shader-lit figure, lightning, and a scroll-driven camera path. The register is brand: the design is the product. Spectacle is never decoration; it is the argument that the author can build hard, polished technical things, and it always resolves into substance (a metric, a venue, a paper). Display type is enormous and set in bold uppercase Iskry; body copy retreats to quiet condensed Saira. The OS pointer is banned in favor of a custom glowing cursor. Motion is exponential and decisive, with a global reduced-motion kill-switch.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed near-black WebGL stage; HTML content scrolls over a living 3D scene.
Monumental Iskry display type (up to 400px) vs. quiet condensed Saira body.
Single signal color (#ff2f00) used sparingly against black and white.
Custom glowing cursor; the native pointer is banned.
Exponential, committed motion with a mandatory reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: #ff2f00 appears on <=10% of any screen. It is signal, never surface.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Cursor Blue (#007fff) exists only as light (box-shadow / text-shadow). Filling a shape with it is forbidden.

rules.name: The Monument Rule
rules.body: Display type is uppercase Iskry with 0.8-1.1 line-height. Never letterspace wider for elegance, never shrink to be safe.

rules.name: The Outline Window Rule
rules.body: Display type over the 3D scene uses a white -webkit-text-stroke outline with transparent fill so the scene reads through.

rules.name: The No-Shadow-On-Flat Rule
rules.body: HTML surfaces cast no drop-shadows. The only sanctioned shadow is the cursor glow.

dos: Do keep #ff2f00 as pure signal - <=10% of any screen, never a surface fill.
Do set display type in oversized uppercase Iskry with 0.8-1.1 line-height.
Do use the white -webkit-text-stroke outline on display type that overlaps the 3D scene.
Do ease with the project's exponential curves (expo-ease-out, power3-ease-out).
Do keep muted body text near the light end of the gray ramp (#cccccc+) so it clears 4.5:1 on black.
Do preserve the global prefers-reduced-motion kill-switch and keep /simple.html + SR-only content accurate.
donts: Don't ship the generic AI-slop template: no gradient cards, no tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows, no hero-metric templates, no identical icon+heading+text card grids.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) anywhere.
Don't add drop-shadows to flat HTML surfaces; the only sanctioned shadow is the #007fff cursor glow.
Don't fill shapes or paint text with Cursor Blue (#007fff) - it is light, not pigment.
Don't let it read like a sterile academic CV or a navy-and-white corporate SaaS landing page.
Don't nest cards, and don't reach for rounded-rectangle cards when space and contrast would separate content better.
